name: Accounts of the Dawning Age
aliases: Accounts of the Dawning Age: Vortex Formations and Egomagical Adaptations
description: A Blood Age tome with smoky glass-like cover kept in the Vaults of Turrau, which Zarek steals.

timeline.summary: Jilesa's truth-spell leads them to the smoky-glass tome and Zarek takes it.
timeline.quote: He didn't hesitate to take the tome, opening it carefully.

timeline.summary: Zarek reveals he manipulated them, takes the book and teleports away, leaving the students to the constructs.
timeline.quote: Your combination of skill and spiteful ambition was invaluable, as I'd expected

relations.note: The tome was moved there from the Mystical Archive.
relations.quote: where many Blood Age artifacts are kept in stasis for safety reasons.

pages_say.description: A Blood Age tome with smoky glass-like cover kept in the Vaults of Turrau, which Zarek steals.
